008package paint.compare;
009
010
011import java.util.Map;
012
013/**
014 * A {@link FieldComparator} that reproduces the <b>strict</b> per-field decision
015 * sequence of the original {@code CsvComparatorRegression} — so the generic
016 * {@link TableComparer} yields the same Java-vs-Java verdicts the old tool did.
017 *
018 * <p>The rules themselves are reused verbatim from {@link RegressionRules}
019 * (rather than re-implemented) so behaviour cannot silently drift from the
020 * original. In order, two values for a column are treated as <em>equal</em> when:</p>
021 * <ol>
022 *   <li>the column is a case-insensitive field and the values match ignoring case;</li>
023 *   <li>one side is empty and the other is a zero/sentinel value;</li>
024 *   <li>the trimmed strings match, or both round to three decimals equally;</li>
025 *   <li>one numeric side is missing (empty/NaN) — treated as not a difference;</li>
026 *   <li>both parse as numbers and, after any track-count-dependent correction,
027 *       fall within the field's strict rounding/relative tolerance.</li>
028 * </ol>
029 * Columns flagged by {@link RegressionRules#isIgnoredColumn} (strict), and blank
030 * column names, are skipped entirely.
031 */
032public final class PaintStrictComparator implements FieldComparator {
033
034    @Override
035    public boolean isIgnored(String column) {
036        return column == null
037                || column.trim().isEmpty()
038                || RegressionRules.isIgnoredColumn(column, false);
039    }
040
041    @Override
042    public boolean equal(String column,
043                         String baselineValue,
044                         String testValue,
045                         Map<String, String> baselineRow,
046                         Map<String, String> testRow) {
047
048        String ov = RegressionRules.clean(baselineValue);
049        String nv = RegressionRules.clean(testValue);
050
051        if (RegressionRules.isIgnoreCaseField(column) && ov.equalsIgnoreCase(nv)) {
052            return true;
053        }
054        if (RegressionRules.emptyAndZeroEquiv(ov, nv)) {
055            return true;
056        }
057        if (RegressionRules.valuesEqual(ov, nv)) {
058            return true;
059        }
060
061        Double od = RegressionRules.parseDouble(ov);
062        Double nd = RegressionRules.parseDouble(nv);
063
064        if (RegressionRules.numericMissingSkipDifference(od, nd)) {
065            return true;
066        }
067
068        if (od != null && nd != null) {
069            Double corrected = RegressionRules.correctedValueIfTrackDependent(
070                    column, od, nd, baselineRow, testRow);
071            return RegressionRules.numericEqualWithTolerance(column, od, corrected, false);
072        }
073
074        return false;
075    }
076}
